rows.cf_policy: Threading the projector may begin only after the **start of the projection test**. Start the projection test only after the film reel is inspected. Dim the house lights from the console.

Threading the projector may begin only after the film reel is inspected. Start the projection test only after threading is finished and the projector is threaded. Dim the house lights from the console.
